name: RIACO Smart Quantity Discount
author: robertoiacono

sections.description:
RIACO Smart Quantity Discount is a flexible WooCommerce plugin that allows you to create advanced pricing rules based on quantity, cart subtotal, or product types. Perfect for store owners who want to offer promotions like:
– Buy X get Y (BOGO)
– Tiered quantity discounts (e.g., buy more, save more)
– Simple percentage or fixed price discounts
– Conditional discounts based on cart total

The plugin supports:
– Product-specific rules
– Rule prioritization with custom priority field
– Non-conflicting rule stacking
– BOGO discounts with auto-added free products

Features

  • Quantity-based discounts
  • BOGO (Buy One Get One Free) promotions
  • Simple fixed/percentage discounts
  • Rule priority handling
  • WooCommerce cart integration
  • Clean admin UI for rule management

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/riaco-smart-quantity-discount/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Smart Quantity Discount to configure discount rules.
sections.faq:
Can I stack multiple discounts?

Yes, but rules are applied based on their priority. Lower priority numbers are applied first. Conflicting rules may override depending on product eligibility.

How does BOGO work?

When a qualifying product is added to the cart, the plugin will automatically add the free product. If the qualifying product is removed, the free item is also removed.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, rules can apply to variable products or specific variations.
